title: The First Days of the Conflux

entities.name: The Conflux
entities.description: The merging of Alara's five shards into one, bringing each shard into war with its two neighbors.

entities.name: Naya
entities.description: Jungle shard of Alara facing an end to its tranquility.

entities.name: Bant
entities.description: Shard of Alara ruled by the Blessed caste, with knights and aven.

entities.name: Esper
entities.description: Shard of etherium, vedalken and sphinxes, whose etherium supplies are running low.

entities.name: Grixis
entities.description: Dying shard of demons and undead, where humanity was going extinct.

entities.name: Jund
entities.description: Ashen shard lit by dragonfire, with warrior-clans, goblins, viashino and hellkites.

entities.name: Mayael
entities.description: Elvish prophet of Naya whose visions guide the elves, Nacatl and behemoths to war.

entities.name: Progenitus
entities.description: Legendary being deep under the Valley of the Ancients whose murmurings convince Mayael that war is needed.

entities.name: Asha
entities.description: Archangel of Bant legend who gave her life to destroy Malfegor.

entities.name: Malfegor
entities.description: Demon-like abomination, Nicol Bolas's general who is told to raise an army of necromancers and undead on Grixis.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Dragon planeswalker biding his time in a secret necropolis lair on Grixis; his minions murmur fears across the shards.

entities.name: Gwafa Hazid
entities.description: Human of Bant, a rule-manipulating caravan-merchant who works for Bolas.

entities.name: The Blessed
entities.description: Ruling caste of Bant facing terrifying reports from its frontiers.

entities.name: The Unbeholden
entities.description: Bant caste of bandits and undisciplined ne'er-do-wells.

entities.name: Carmot
entities.description: Red stone said to be crucial to manufacturing new etherium.

events.summary: The shards merge in the Conflux; the lands overlap, new colors of mana flood every world and war breaks out on two fronts for each shard.
events.quote: Five worlds have merged into one.

events.summary: Naya's elves, Nacatl and behemoths march to war with Bant and Jund, guided by Mayael's visions of Progenitus.
events.quote: Guided by the visions of the elvish prophet Mayael, the elves, the Nacatl, and the earthshaking behemoths of Naya march to war with its new neighbors.

events.summary: Bant's Blessed face Esper's metallic horrors and Naya's encroaching jungle, and the knight-captains find their ceremonial combat naive as massed armies fight.
events.quote: The angels seem powerless to enforce Bant's cherished law, and soldiers fall by the hundreds.

events.summary: Esper's sphinxes decide war is the only recourse after their etherium gifts are spurned, and Esper mages go hunting carmot.
events.quote: The sphinxes decide that war is the only recourse

events.summary: Grixis's demons and undead swarm across the borders to feed on the life essence of the neighboring shards.
events.quote: the demons and undead horrors swarm into the adjacent borderlands like a plague, gorging on all the life essence they encounter.

events.summary: Nicol Bolas orders his general Malfegor to assemble an army of necromancers and undead and destroy remaining human holdouts on Grixis.
events.quote: He bids Malfegor assemble an army of the most powerful necromancers and the most horrifying undead

events.summary: Jund's goblins and landwurms spill into the neighboring shards and hellkites find new threats to their dominion.
events.quote: The goblin tribes of Jund began to explore the new lands

relations.quote: confers with his general, the abomination known as Malfegor

relations.note: Per Bant legend, Asha gave her life to destroy Malfegor.
relations.quote: an archangel who gave her life to destroy the demonic menace Malfegor
That's probably his trajectory, the longer he works for Bolas.
Gwafa Hazid is a human being of Bant.
whisper strange, dire truths into Mayael's visions
